_comment: Table of the skill-load-gate PreToolUse hook (scripts/skill-load-gate.mjs). Each rule names one governed action and the skill that must be loaded in the session before it runs. A rule matches by `tool` (JS regex on the tool name; with `path`, a regex the tool's target file must also match) or by `command` (a Bash command segment whose program and subcommand match; with `argument`, a regex one of its tokens must also match; the program is recognised at the start of a segment, after shell keywords and command prefixes such as `then`, `timeout 60` or `rtk`, and inside a command or process substitution). `path` is matched without regard to case. A Bash call is matched by `command` rules only, never by a `tool` rule. `skill` is the lower-case name exactly as the Skill tool takes it. `alwaysLoaded` lists the skills the entry file imports into every session; they count as loaded without a Skill call. scripts/tests/skill-load-gate.test.sh holds one refused and one allowed case per rule and a refused case for every other alternative a rule lists: add them with every new rule or alternative.
